inj.note: The Rams already are without WR Davante Adams for a few more weeks after he underwent surgery on his left hamstring, and the team now may be sans Nacua if the results of Monday's testing go a certain way. L.A. doesn't believe that Nacua sustained a torn ACL, but the MRI will reveal what type of damage he incurred. Before picking up the injury on the Rams' final offensive snap, Nacua gathered in 14 of 19 targets for 150 yards and one touchdown and took two carries for 20 yards.

news.h: Sources: Puka Nacua set for tests on late-game knee injury; Rams believe ACL OK
news.d: The Rams do not believe Puka Nacua suffered a torn ACL, but the imaging Monday will tell more, sources said.

news.h: Puka Nacua, Myles Garrett lead Rams to 20-13 win over Commanders
news.d: — There's still room for growth from the star-studded Rams, but they're starting to show again why they were a preseason Super Bowl favorite.
